PocketOption.default: High-level client for the Pocket Option trading platform. Provides methods for trading, balance retrieval, historical data, real-time subscriptions and connection management over a managed WebSocket connection.

new_with_url.default: Creates a new PocketOption client that connects to a specific WebSocket server URL instead of the platform default.

trade.default: Places a trade on the given asset. `action` selects Call (price up) or Put (price down), `time` is the expiry in seconds and `amount` the stake. Returns the created Deal.

result.default: Waits for the final result of a trade by its UUID string and returns the settled Deal, including profit.

open_pending_order.default: Opens a pending order that triggers at a given time or price. `command` selects the direction (0 = Call, 1 = Put) and `min_payout` filters by minimum payout percentage.

subscribe.default: Subscribes to real-time time-aligned candles for an asset. `duration_secs` sets the candle duration; `subfor` (default true) controls whether the standard `subfor` subscription frame is sent after `changeSymbol`.

candles.default: Retrieves historical OHLC candle data for an asset. Variants allow selecting period, offset and starting time.

create_raw_handler.default: Creates a raw message handler bound to a validator, for sending custom frames and receiving matching responses. An optional keep-alive message is re-sent after every reconnect.
